summary: Lebanese university with campuses in Beirut, Debbieh, Tripoli and Bekaa. Most degrees are taught in English; Law, Mass Communication and Psychology are in Arabic.

ib.text: No IB points minimum published. A full IB Diploma needs MEHE equivalence, then the admission exam for your programme plus an English test. Course Results alone are not addressed.

notes: IB route: BAU lists a full IB Diploma among non-Lebanese certificates that need an Equivalence from the Lebanese education ministry (MEHE). Holders then sit the admission exam for their programme; BAU calls this entry the sophomore (first-year) class.

The separate Freshman programme (30 credits, SAT 950 sciences / 870 arts, MEHE freshman permission) is for 12-year foreign certificates. It adds a year; BAU does not say which applies to IB, so ask the Admissions Office.

No IB point minimum or subject-grade conversion is published. IB Course Results alone are not addressed. Admission depends on programme capacity and the exam; acceptance holds for one academic year and a non-refundable deposit confirms the place.

English proof: TOEFL paper 520, computer-based 180, SAT reading and writing 480, IELTS 5.5, or the BAU English exam at 60%. TOEFL iBT score was not readable; codes are 7373 (SAT) and B516 (TOEFL iBT). Failing the BAU English exam means intensive English courses.

Documents: certificate or Grade 12 registration proof, Grade 10-11 transcripts, SAT if applicable, ID or passport, photo, and a USD 50 fee. Fees page says tuition is paid in USD and LBP parts and "fees are subject to change".
Recognition: BAU says the Lebanese Ministry of Education and Higher Education recognises all its degrees, and it holds FIBAA institutional accreditation.

Civil and Computer Engineering run at Debbieh/Tripoli (and Bekaa for Computer Engineering) per the 2026-27 programme list; the Beirut campus does not list them. Architecture is listed at Debbieh and Tripoli. Check the campus before applying.

Years: Civil and Computer Engineering give 10 semesters; Architecture gives five years. Durations of other degrees were not read, so they are not listed. Spring 2027 entry also opens 19 October 2026 (exam 27 January 2027).
The cited Bekaa campus offers new 2027-28 programmes with up to 35% financial aid; terms are on the admissions page.
